protocol.gap_rule: largest sorted gap > max(0.5 Hz, 3x median sorted gap)

reference_departures.departure: 30 s rollout and 5 s transient check
reference_departures.reason: resolve the observed dnb08 regime split

self_interrogation.g: rewired and random diagnostic controls use seed 20260830
self_interrogation.h: This diagnostic tests regime stability, not labeled-line specificity.

options_considered: measure real, negative-control, and graph-null spreads
decisions_taken.why: dnb08 non-monotonicity and run-2 gate failure require regime diagnosis before grid
